name: Bourbon Signal
subtitle: Fresh bourbon intelligence
promotionalText: See timely bourbon availability Signals from trusted sources and members, with exact details when the evidence supports them.
description:
Bourbon Signal gives existing members a focused, trustworthy view of timely bourbon availability intelligence.

Use the native app to:
• Review recent availability and release Signals
• Open exact Signal details, including retailer, timing, price, quantity, and source context when available
• Privately record an optional Hunt Outcome after an availability Signal expires
• Monitor watched bottles, saved markets, and recent alerts in Radar
• Post a store sighting with durable duplicate protection
• Open My Shelf, keep bottle notes, and explicitly choose what to watch next
• Check your membership, Signal Points, and available rewards in Account

Availability changes quickly. Bourbon Signal presents the strongest current evidence available, but inventory should always be confirmed with the retailer before travel or purchase.

The app is a companion for existing Bourbon Signal accounts. It does not sell subscriptions or direct members to an external checkout.
contentRights: Bourbon Signal owns or is authorized to use the submitted app artwork, copy, and product content.
ageRatingNote: The service is intended for adults age 21 and older and contains alcohol-related product information. Complete Apple's current age-rating questionnaire honestly; do not hard-code a rating in automation.
reviewContact: Enter the organization-controlled review contact directly in App Store Connect; do not commit private contact details here.
reviewAccount: Create a dedicated least-privilege review account after App Store Connect access exists. Store credentials only in App Store Connect review information.
